Quantum 1.40.0 was certified on 2026-10-06. It pins **nucleus v1.31.0**, **quark v1.16.0** and **orbit v1.19.1**, with 25 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.39.0: quark goes from v1.15.2 to v1.16.0 (minor), orbit goes from v1.18.1 to v1.19.1 (minor) and nucleus stays at v1.31.0. 10 sibling modules change version.
